mapper.select: select id, username, password_hash, role, identity_type, identity_id from user_account order by id asc
mapper.insert: insert into user_account(username, password_hash, role, identity_type, identity_id) values(#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{identityType}, #{identityId})
mapper.update: update user_account set username = #{username}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, role = #{role}, identity_type = #{identityType}, identity_id = #{identityId} where id = #{id}
